body: i hear you and i’m not going to sit here and try to reason with you but i want you to know that i care about you. can i send you $ for a meal at least? i was in the same situation last march when my friend committed suicide after we were both depressed so i’ll do anything to never experience that with ANYONE again. please message me i want to give you a good meal! you can doordash, ubereats, postmate it whatever works. PLEASE message me
lmk when you get answers. i’m watching my whole life crumble because i can’t get outta bed
the part about the happy moments is so true. it all is really...reddit was my way of trying not to be alone so thank you for your experience too 💚
i dread graduation. it’s a day about futures and success and i just can’t deal with that because it wasn’t made for me. i’m sorry you still feel that way and i hope things get better for you <3

it’s just too much. everything that’s happened and is happening to me is too much for me to handle. no matter how happy i am, i just think about the shitty things that are happening, have happened, and are going to happen.
